name: Ahmad bin Jamal
bio:
Ahmad's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly, sparked by a childhood fascination with the roar of engines from a nearby go-kart track. He started as a volunteer, meticulously cleaning and organizing tools, always observing the mechanics at work. This hands-on experience fueled his desire to contribute to the sport in a more significant way. He pursued vocational training in engineering and quickly learned the importance of precision and attention to detail. 

As a quality control specialist, Ahmad is known for his unwavering commitment to maintaining standards. He believes in thorough inspection and proactive problem-solving. While he's still developing his technical skills, his dedication and methodical approach make him a valuable asset to any team. He is eager to learn from experienced colleagues and contribute to the team's success through his diligence and unwavering loyalty.

What sets Ahmad apart is his quiet determination and passion for continuous improvement. He spends hours studying technical manuals and seeking feedback to refine his skills. His dedication to quality is not just a job; it's a personal commitment to excellence.

physical.description: Ahmad has a lean build and kind eyes that reflect his calm and focused demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small magnifying glass to examine parts.
Insists on using a specific brand of microfiber cloth for cleaning.
Humms softly while concentrating on tasks.
